newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Discount Auto venture accretive.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Discount Auto venture accretive.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities said on Wednesday it expects that Discount Auto Parts Inc's planned joint venture with Q Lube Inc, a Quaker State Corp subsidiary, could add between $0.01 and $0.03 to its Discount Auto fiscal 1997 earnings estimate.
-- "We will not, however, change our number until we have some concrete numbers as to revenue and profit contribution," EVEREN added.
-- Its estimates remain $1.65 for fiscal 1997 and $1.95 for fiscal 1998. A market performer rating is maintained.

-- On October 1, Q Lube and Discount Auto said they signed a letter of intent to enter into a joint venture, opening centers for retail sale of automotive parts and lube and automotive maintenance services.
-- Discount Auto shares were up 5/8 at 26.
